Officer's narrative
Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection, I found two vehicles in a low-speed head-on collision. Driver 1 was
operating the northbound sedan and Driver 2 was operating the southbound sedan. A Passenger was seated in the
front passenger position of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 told me of neck and back strain, and the reported symptoms
are consistent with the forces expected in a collision of this type. Damage to both front ends matches the impact
described by the drivers. Scene photographs confirm several of the reported positions and points of contact. No
independent witnesses were located, so the account rests on the statements of those involved and on the physical
evidence. I confirmed through my observations and through statements at the scene that the Passenger was in the
vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 advised that the vehicle had no prior damage to my knowledge, and I observed
no signs of earlier repairs. Driver 1 stated that they reside in the same household as the named policyholder, and that
the policyholder's household members are generally covered under the policy. No citations were issued at the scene.
